name: hylite
description: Hylite — Semantic search engine for workplace policies, legal sources, grounded paragraph annotations, and conflict detection.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
